rows.text: copies the 64 bytes at `rcx+0x250` to a stack matrix and, by bits 2-4 of byte `+0x4A` of R = qword `rcx+0x20`, calls an 861-byte routine on it with `02AEEC30` (1), `02AEEC70` (2), or `02AEEA60` after a 360-byte routine (4) or a 466-byte routine (5); calls a 13-byte helper (dword `rcx+0x290`), a 195-byte helper (`02AEECB0`) and a 567-byte routine with `02AE0310`; returns unless R byte `+0x240` is 2 or 4 and a 728-byte routine (`R+0x1A0`, out, 0, dword `rcx+0x44`) returns non-null; fills globals `02AEE908`, `02AEE900`, `02AE0370`, `02AE0360`, `02AE02B0`, `02AE02B4` and `02AE02A0` to `02AE02AC`; then, when P = `0020E600(dword R+0x2A0+4*dword rcx+0x298)` is non-null, calls the 195-byte helper (`02AEECB0`) again and, by bits 1-2 of R byte `+0x294` (0 returns), sets dword `02AE0280` to 0 (1) or 2 (2) and calls a 154-byte routine (bits 0-2 of R word `+0x24A` clear) or a 280-byte routine with `0x118`, the address of a 7,726-byte routine and `0020E600(dword P+0x10)`; 3 calls twice, `02AE0280` = 2 then 0
